text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races 
alongside Curren Chan—

With suitcases in hand, Curren Chan and I 
arrived at the hot spring inn we'd won 
from the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We've arrived! The hot spring inn!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's got such a relaxing atmosphere, just 
perfect for taking a breather♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's gonna go check out the hot 
springs~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll leave it to you, Big Brother~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Leave it to your big sister~♪

Curren Chan seemed to be in even higher 
spirits than usual. Apparently, she had 
really been looking forward to the hot 
springs.
And so, right away—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~. I wonder if my skin got all smooth 
and silky♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is Curren getting cuter? Is she glowing? 
Sparkle sparkle~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey... are you just nodding along without 
listening?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. You really are always 
thinking about Curren, aren't you, Big 
Brother?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. You really are always 
thinking about Curren, aren't you, Big 
Sister?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even this hot spring trip is the same. To 
tell the truth... Curren was, you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might be able to relax 
better without Curren around, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I just thought that without Curren around, 
you'd be able to spread your wings a bit, 
Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because Curren knows she's been doing 
whatever she wants. Making selfish 
decisions, dragging big brother around, 
making you tag along...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because Curren knows she's been doing 
whatever she wants. Making selfish 
decisions, dragging big sister around, 
making you tag along...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you'll accept everything about me, 
Big Bro. ...Or at least, that's why I 
chose you as my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you'll accept everything about me, 
Big Sis. ...Or at least, that's why I 
chose you as my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, I know. You don't actually dislike it 
at all, do you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not perfect, you try to 
understand what Curren wants to do... and 
you want to see her dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You're always trying to stay right there 
beside me. I never even imagined someone 
like that could exist."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I wanted you to rest 
somewhere without Curren around."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even if Curren knows everything, I can't 
just keep quiet to spare your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because that wouldn't be... the Curren 
that Big Brother wants to see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because that wouldn't be... the Curren 
that Big Sister wants to see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. For doting on Curren so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren was invincible all on her own. 
But... you gave her another reason to stay 
invincible, another reason to stay true to 
cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because of that reason, Curren's path can 
shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think you're "cute" too, Onii-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think you're "cute" too, Onee-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Keep thinking of Curren allll the time, 
okay? And thenâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Love Curren even moooore, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sis!

It was a precious moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Curren Chan...
